title: Certified exemplar custody and change-triggered resampling workflow
creator: Avery Chen
description: Background: We need a durable custody model for the small set of canonical example items ("certified exemplars") used by regression evals that are triggered by model/config changes. Current ad-hoc prompt bundles live in buckets with weak provenance which causes drift, accidental edits, and unclear ownership. This ticket proposes a custody + resampling workflow to ensure deterministic regen, permissioned edits, and automated change-triggered re-evals.
problem_statement: When platform configs or model binaries change, the eval harness must be able to detect regressions against a trusted baseline. Without signed provenance and a reproducible sampling policy we risk undetected quality regressions, noisy alerts from spurious edits, and lack of auditability for compliance-sensitive customers.
proposal_summary: 1) Introduce an Exemplar Registry: documents each certified exemplar (id, sha256, signer, curated_tags, canonical prompt/seed) and exposes immutable snapshots. 2) Adopt signed manifests: all registry snapshots are signed by a steward key (KMS-backed) to prevent silent edits. 3) Implement Change-Triggered Resampling: on config/model change events the registry publishes a deterministic delta that instructs the eval orchestrator which exemplars to re-run and when to rotate a small fraction of exemplars for sample-variance checks. 4) ACLs + UI flows: Console exposes steward roles, request/approve flows, and an audit timeline for each exemplar snapshot.
acceptance_criteria:
- Exemplar Registry MVP deployed with JSON manifest store and sha256 signing.
- Registry implements read-only snapshots with unique signed identifier (ex: EXR-20250301-0001).
- Config-change webhook consumes signed manifest and schedules re-eval jobs automatically for affected workloads.
- Console shows exemplar details, last-signed-by, and a simple request/approve UI for edits.
- Integration test: change a runtime config in staging -> registry triggers re-eval -> alerts generated only if metric delta > threshold.
- Security review completed and KMS keys rotated per policy.
out_of_scope: Full lineage UI for every historical edit (we'll store audit logs but not a full visualization in this phase). Bulk migration of all existing prompt bundles (we'll import high-value sets only).
implementation_notes: Engineering will provide a minimal manifest API (GET /registry/{snapshot}) and a validation CLI for signing/verifying manifests. We'll use SHA-256 fingerprints in the manifest and KMS for signing. Resampling algorithm: a deterministic pseudo-random selection seeded by the manifest id + change-event-id to pick 5-10% exemplar rotations; seeds recorded in manifest. Eval orchestrator will accept a 'manifest_version' param to ensure runs are attributable to a snapshot.
risks_and_mitigations:
- Risk: Signed manifests add operational complexity. Mitigation: Provide a small steward CLI and managed KMS onboarding docs.
- Risk: Re-eval storm on large config changes. Mitigation: backoff policy + staged rollouts (canary snapshot first).
- Risk: Steward key compromise. Mitigation: require offline approval for key rotation and short-lived signer tokens.
rollout_plan: 1) Alpha: internal-only registry + CLI + stubbed Console page (2 sprints). 2) Beta: integrate with config-change webhook and staging eval runs (1 sprint). 3) GA: enable steward ACLs, sign all new snapshots, and run migration for top 10 golden sets (1 sprint).
